mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_inventory_in ORDER BY in_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_inventory_in (in_no, in_type, material_id, material_name, quantity, unit_price, total_amount, supplier_id, warehouse_id, in_date, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{inNo}, #{inType}, #{materialId}, #{materialName}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalAmount}, #{supplierId}, #{warehouseId}, #{inDate}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_inventory_in SET in_no = #{inNo}, in_type = #{inType}, material_id = #{materialId}, material_name = #{materialName}, quantity = #{quantity}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, supplier_id = #{supplierId}, warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, in_date = #{inDate}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
